# Synthetic Pain Observation Workflow

## Purpose
This generated fixture is a sandbox-only text sample for lexical retrieval. It describes simulated discomfort observation steps without any real person, real facility, or clinical authority.

## Structured Observation
- Ask the training actor to choose a synthetic comfort score from the exercise card.
- Note visible posture changes from the scripted scenario.
- Separate observed signals from assumptions.
- Mark uncertain findings for human training review.

## Deterministic Notes
The words discomfort, posture, comfort score, and review appear intentionally so lexical retrieval can find this generated document during tests.

## Safety Boundary
The fixture is synthetic generated content only. It is not a recommendation, not a registry entry, and not suitable for operational use.
